question: In a certain language, RAM is written as SBN. How will SHYAM be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c862ea9c33a633c54bfcf4c329c66d9a52118504f28cbfbfdf760e12f52cc05.png] 

The logic followed here is:

RAM is written as SBN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b07c79bcebaf693ac449afa739bc839a1ff87bb295922d94138900faec50808.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b4a3ecda28314df5ffd06527d5e0506ec45112a539d024940e5a605a23dbfba.png] 

Similarly, SHYAM will be written:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36ffcce182de9639ae98fc968b2efa6292be25d3b74d2f35a0a97e917eecc040.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d347a37e2f4602b6f4c5ba4f6729e49eb90f84e02f08cfe1f3ec882a524b237.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**TIZBN**".
